# prodbykctw-max.github.io

> Web games, apps and reference projects by KCTW (Melvin D. Brown III), co-founder and lead developer of RARE Agency. The main reference work here is Divine Origins, a comparative theology library.

## Pages
- [Projects](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/): every project on this site
- [About KCTW](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/about/): who builds these projects
- [Contact](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/contact/): email and project inquiries
- [Privacy](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/privacy/): no accounts, no cookies, no analytics

## Sites
- [Divine Origins](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/divine-origins/): comparative theology library with a Source Map of creator gods across traditions. Full summary: [llms.txt](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/divine-origins/llms.txt)
- [CREASE](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/crease-iphone-duo/): air hockey for the iPhone Duo
- [Will Hill: Player One](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/will-hill-player-one-game/): Atlanta runner game
- [Jandé: Once Upon A Time](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/once-upon-a-time/): browser game for Jandé's song
- [Lala Luna Land](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/LaLa-Luna-Land-Game/): 3D island adventure
- [Corner Store Dash](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/EBT-PRESENTS-CORNER-STORE-DASH/): EBT browser game
- [MACRO](https://prodbykctw-max.github.io/macro-app/): protein and meal-planning tool
